title_en: Furnished 1+1 apartment for sale in the Mosque near the Botanical Garden
description_en: Furnished 1+1 apartment for sale in the Mosque near the Botanical Garden. The apartment has a gross area of ​​67.7 m², favorable south-west orientation, it is located on the 4th floor of a residential building with an elevator and is sold (not with a loan) for 129,000 euros.
